locations.name: Shyboy Hi Fi — Shawn Dub + Kels
locations.note: Vinyl-only listening bar downtown. Free with RSVP, walk-ups welcome if patient. Doors 6 PM, open til 2 AM. Get there before 9 to beat the line.

locations.name: Ladylove Lounge & Sound
locations.note: Record lounge in Bishop Arts. Nightly curated DJ sets, strict no-requests. Kitchen open to close — banh mi is the move. Happy hour 5–8 PM, 21+. Best as the early stop.

locations.name: Double D's
locations.note: Design District cocktail bar with DJs, dancing, pool, and N64. No ticket, no kitchen — eat first. 5 PM–2 AM. Line forms later in the night.

locations.name: It'll Do Club — Jody Wisternoff
locations.note: Anjunadeep royalty on Deep Ellum's famous light-up floor. 9 PM–2 AM, 21+, no refunds. Surround sound system, house heads' home turf.

locations.name: CTRL Room — BL3SS
locations.note: BL3SS headlines with Rick Slick b2b Louie Louie in support. 10 PM–2 AM, 21+. Same building as Tree Haus — two parties, one address.

locations.name: Tree Haus — K-Pop Night: Enhypen After Party
locations.note: DJs Paul & Daewu spin the Enhypen after party. 10 PM–2 AM, 21+, ID required. Shares the building with CTRL Room — easy to bounce between both.

locations.name: Tulips FTW — Work It! 90s/00s R&B & Hip Hop
locations.note: Missy, Nelly, TLC, Biggie throwbacks in Near Southside Fort Worth. Doors 9:30 PM, 18+ to enter / 21+ to drink. ~35–40 min drive from the Dallas cluster — plan it as its own night or the main event.

locations.name: Downtown Core
locations.note: Shyboy Hi Fi's turf. Main St bars and easy rideshare pickups.

locations.name: Deep Ellum
locations.note: The nightlife spine — It'll Do on the east end, CTRL Room / Tree Haus on the northwest edge. Everything walkable-ish, rideshare between ends.

locations.name: Design District
locations.note: Double D's home turf, across the river from downtown.

locations.name: Bishop Arts
locations.note: Ladylove's neighborhood. Great dinner-first stop, parking is rough — valet or rideshare.

locations.name: Near Southside (FTW)
locations.note: Tulips FTW's district in Fort Worth — the one out-of-town cluster, ~35–40 min from Dallas.
